name: bugfix_praetorian_mitigation
description: Semantic fix: the Praetorian buff description does not match its effect. BUFF_Plus20DamageMitgation_NonStacking, granted by ABP_Praetorian, internally uses BUFF_Plus20Damage_1Turn (+20% damage) as its effect carrier, contradicting its "+20% Damage Mitigation" description. Rewrites the name table with a variable-length edit (2 new names) and redirects two import entries to BUFF_20DamageMitigation_1Turn (PercentageMitigation=0.2, TurnsLeft=1), which matches the intended semantics. AddBuff/HasBuff EX_ObjectConst references use the import index and follow automatically.
source: Clean Steam baseline, Build 1837603 (edited in place; no assets from refs/PC_EE are referenced).
grading: L0: post-rebuild re-analysis passed (name count, imports entry by entry, export SerialOffset+Size, byte-for-byte data, decode_bp function list). L2/L3 not verified.
install_note: First package built with the variable-length uasset editor. If loading fails with a fatal error, roll back and inspect (the earlier BFL variable-length fatal issue does not apply here: this edit does not change bytecode, only shifts tables).

detail.what: Redirect imports and add 2 name-table entries (variable-length)
